description: Look up a MIME type by type string or file extension. Accepts "image/webp", ".webp", or "webp". Returns the canonical MIME type, known file extensions, whether the type is compressible (relevant for Content-Encoding decisions), and the data source (iana, apache, nginx). For extension lookups, returns the canonical MIME type — e.g., ".jpg" resolves to "image/jpeg". When multiple types map to an extension, the canonical type is returned first with alternatives listed.

query.description: MIME type string (e.g., "application/json", "image/webp") or file extension with or without leading dot (e.g., ".webp", "webp", "js", ".html").

name: ref_mime_type

alternatives.description: Other MIME types that also map to the queried extension, when multiple types share the extension.

items.description: An alternative MIME type mapping to the same extension.

compressible.description: True when this type is compressible (e.g., text and JSON types); false when not; null when unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: The MIME type or file extension is not recognized. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

extensions.description: Known file extensions for this MIME type, without leading dots.

title: MIME Type Lookup
